title: Lid Cover Broken (Storm Sewer/Manhole)
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: Use this service request to report a broken sewer/manhole lid cover. The department will investigate to determine the type of lid cover. ** If issue appears hazardous please call 3-1-1 ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.question: What type of lid is it?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

pathCoverage: All three lid types and all six location choices tried; Other revealed required description.
Continue advanced to Contact. No contact data entered.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a broken sewer or storm sewer manhole lid cover, including an inlet cover or grate, where the issue does not appear hazardous.
actions.why: For a broken sewer or storm sewer manhole lid cover, including an inlet cover or grate, where the issue does not appear hazardous. The 311 request asks lid type and location.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Lid Cover Broken (Storm Sewer/Manhole)" requests is not the directed route when the issue appears hazardous. If it appears hazardous, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Lid Cover Broken (Storm Sewer/Manhole)"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Lid Cover Broken (Storm Sewer/Manhole)"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 about an apparently hazardous broken sewer lid.
actions.why: For a broken sewer/manhole lid cover that appears hazardous; the description for "Lid Cover Broken (Storm Sewer/Manhole)" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs people to call 3-1-1.
